intro_text: While patrolling the border, the cats notice some disturbing signs: strange scratch marks on trees, paw markings leading into their territory, and the stale scent of decay. The patrol fears that their Clanmates may be in danger.

The cat's pelt is completely obscured and unrecognisable, so the patrol rushes back to camp to ensure that it's not any of their Clanmates.

The patrol follows the scent until they discover the source-- a fresh pile of dirt at the edge of the Twolegplace. A worn kittypet collar rests on top of it. The patrol sends a solemn prayer to StarClan for the kittypet, and even for its Twolegs, who must be grieving the poor cat.

The patrol investigates the scent, prepared for an infected cat to pop out of the bush at any moment. When they find the source of the scent, however, it's simply an infected squirrel, scratching up the bark of a tree mindlessly, The patrol puts it out of its misery and buries it far from camp.
